content: As ubbas lo7o ooso
Ta ishato! Issi asi nagara ooththi bettikko inte qas Ayanan lo7o dizayti iza ashiketethara zaaranas bessees; gido attin nekka izade mala paacetonta mala ne hu7es naageta.
Inte issoy issa deexxo tooho tookkite; hessa mala ooson Kirstoosa woga poleeta.
Issadey aynne hanonta dishe bana gitasiza misatikko hessadey barka bana baleththes.
Issi issi asi ba ooso barka paaci xeello. Hessafe guye hara asara bana ginasonta dishe izi bana ceeqqisizazi demmana.
Issi issi asi barka ba tooho tookkanas bessees.
Qaala tamarizay oonikka ba tamarida lo7o miisha ba astamarezara gishetto.
Baletofte Xoossi qilica erenna. Asi ba zeridaro izo zaari maxana.
Ba asho amo kunthanas zerizadey ashoppe dhayssi maxana. Ayana ufayssanas zeridadey gidikko ayanappe merna de7o maxana.
Ane nu lo7o ooso ooththanas azallokko; nu ufaysi qanxonta agikko wodey gakkishin gakkida kath nu maxana.
Hessa gish nuus dandayettikko asa ubbas harappeka ammaniza asas ane lo7o ooththoos.
Wursetha zorenne sarokka
Tani ta kushera intes ay mala gita pidalen xaafidakkone ane xeellite.
Coo kare baggara bettana koyiza asati inte qaxxarettana mala wolqathana koyeettes. Isti hessa ooththizay Kirstoosa masqale gish giidi goodetonta malassa.
Isti inte qaxxarettana mala koyizay inte ashon ceeqqettanas koyiza gish attin qaxxaretidayti woga naagizayta gidettenna.
Qasse alamey taas; takka alames; kaqettida Goda Yesus Kirstoosa masqalenppe attin haran ceeqoy taappe haakko.
Qaxxaretin woykko qaxxaretonta aggin izas go7ay baawa. Go7ay ooratha medheteth gideththa.
Hayssa ha azazoza kaalliza ubbatasinne Xoossa dere gidida Isra7eele asatas sarotethinne maaroteth gido.
Tani Yesusa malata ta asatethan tookkadis; hessa gish ha7i tana oonikka waaysenna.
Ta ishato! Goda Yesus Kirstoosa aadho kiyatethi intenara gido! Amiin.
